title: A scientific future shared with AI
content:
by Renee Hoch, Joanna Clarke

Artificial intelligence (AI) tools now exist to aid almost every aspect of the research process, from hypothesis generation and data analysis to manuscript drafting and publication. What does the future hold for researchers and publishers as AI use continues to increase? AI tools now exist to aid almost every aspect of the research process, from hypothesis generation and data analysis to manuscript drafting and publication. This Editorial examines what the future might hold for researchers and publishers as AI use continues to increase.
author: Renee Hoch
